notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix – Prestige Skin & Buff Fixes
notes.content:
We've fixed two issues related to prestige progression:

[list]
[*] Skins now correctly cycle based on your prestige level, preventing errors at higher levels.
[*] Prestige buffs were unintentionally stacking multiple times, causing inflated income. This has been corrected.
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback and reports! 🛠️

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – v1.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]More clarity, stronger clicks, and smoother progression![/h1]

[h2]🔍 Building Tooltips Now Show More Info[/h2]

Ever wondered what your buildings are really doing? Now you’ll see:
[list]
[*] Their base coin output
[*] Total production per second
[*] And how much they’ve earned over time
[/list]
Knowledge is profit!

[h2]🧑‍🎨 Player Level Display Improved[/h2]

To reduce confusion around prestige stars, we've added a clear level indicator below your avatar. You’ll still see your prestige symbol, but now your current level is also front and center.

[h2]👆 Click Upgrades Reworked[/h2]

Click upgrades now stack more effectively!
Instead of every level giving +100%, upgrades now scale like this:
+100%, +200%, +300%... up to +1000%
This makes each upgrade feel stronger and more rewarding.

[h2]🧬 Talent System Fixes & Balance Pass[/h2]

Fixed an issue where the Prestige Limit Reduction talent wasn’t working as intended.
All talents have been rebalanced for a smoother and more strategic progression.

[h2]🎨 Skin Update Fix[/h2]

Characters now properly update their skin when leveling up. Style and strength, all in one.

[h2]🧹 Miscellaneous UI Improvements[/h2]

We’ve cleaned up a few visual elements and polished the overall interface.


Thanks for playing Coin Smith and for all your feedback! This update brings better clarity, stronger upgrades, and a more satisfying idle experience. 💰✨

notes.title: 🚀 The Prestige System is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’re excited to announce that the ⭐ Prestige System is now officially live! 🎉

From the start, we promised that your efforts wouldn't go to waste—and we’ve kept that promise.
The game has quietly tracked your lifetime progress, and now it’s time to turn that dedication into rewards.

💡 [b]How does it work?[/b]
Every time you choose to Prestige, you’ll reset your current progress in exchange for 🪙 Eternal Coins.
The amount of Eternal Coins you receive is based on how much you’ve earned across your entire journey.
The more you exceed the prestige threshold, the more 🪙 coins you'll earn—following a balanced progression curve that rewards long-term effort without punishing new players.

And don’t worry—you’ll naturally reach the point where you can Prestige as you accumulate more wealth.
There’s no pressure or secret unlock—you’ll simply encounter it as part of your journey.

✨ [b]How to Prestige[/b]:
- On the main screen, you’ll notice a ⭐ Prestige Progress Bar. When it’s full, it means you’re eligible to Prestige.
- Tap the ⭐ Prestige icon at any time to open the Talent Tree and view your current progress.
- If you can Prestige, a Level Up button will appear at the top left of the Talent Tree.
- Tapping Level Up will show a confirmation pop-up. It will explain that your progress will reset, but you’ll gain 🪙 Eternal Coins and a Prestige Level.
- Once you Prestige, you can start unlocking Talents.
- On the Talent Tree, hovering over each Talent will show a tooltip with its effects and requirements.
- To unlock a Talent, you need to press and hold on it—this prevents accidental unlocks.

🔥 [b]What’s new[/b]:
- ⭐ Prestige to earn 🪙 Eternal Coins
- Unlock powerful Talents to speed up future runs
- A minimum earnings threshold is required—but everything you’ve earned so far already counts

This is just the start! More talents, rewards, and customization options will come in future updates.
